details.question: What was the staff headcount in Illinois in 2023?
details.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(staff_eap.total_employees) AS "staff_headcount"
FROM ipeds_employees_by_position AS staff_eap
LEFT JOIN ipeds_institution AS institution ON staff_eap.unitid = institution.unitid
WHERE institution.state_abbr = 'IL'
  AND staff_eap.survey_year = 2023
  AND staff_eap.is_category_total = FALSE

details.question: Staff FTE by sector in 2023
details.sql:
SELECT
  institution.sector_code AS "sector",
  SUM(staff_eap.full_time + staff_eap.part_time / 3.0) AS "staff_fte"
FROM ipeds_employees_by_position AS staff_eap
LEFT JOIN ipeds_institution AS institution ON staff_eap.unitid = institution.unitid
WHERE staff_eap.survey_year = 2023
  AND staff_eap.is_category_total = FALSE
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "sector"

details.question: Full-time staff headcount at public four-year institutions in 2023
details.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(staff_eap.full_time) AS "full_time_staff_headcount"
FROM ipeds_employees_by_position AS staff_eap
LEFT JOIN ipeds_institution AS institution ON staff_eap.unitid = institution.unitid
WHERE institution.sector_code = '1'
  AND staff_eap.survey_year = 2023
  AND staff_eap.is_category_total = FALSE

details.question: Top 2 institutions by staff headcount in 2023
details.sql:
SELECT
  institution.institution_name AS "institution_name",
  SUM(staff_eap.total_employees) AS "staff_headcount"
FROM ipeds_employees_by_position AS staff_eap
LEFT JOIN ipeds_institution AS institution ON staff_eap.unitid = institution.unitid
WHERE staff_eap.survey_year = 2023
  AND staff_eap.is_category_total = FALSE
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "staff_headcount" DESC NULLS LAST, "institution_name"
LIMIT 2

details.question: Staff headcount by year
details.sql:
SELECT
  staff_eap.survey_year AS "survey_year",
  SUM(staff_eap.total_employees) AS "staff_headcount"
FROM ipeds_employees_by_position AS staff_eap
WHERE staff_eap.is_category_total = FALSE
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "survey_year"

details.question: Average faculty salary in Illinois
details.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(salary_instructional.salary_outlays) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(salary_instructional.staff_count), 0) AS "avg_instructional_salary"
FROM ipeds_salary_instructional AS salary_instructional
LEFT JOIN ipeds_institution AS institution ON salary_instructional.unitid = institution.unitid
WHERE institution.state_abbr = 'IL'
  AND salary_instructional.contract_length = '9-month'

details.question: Average faculty salary by academic rank for public four-year institutions
details.sql:
SELECT
  salary_instructional.academic_rank AS "academic_rank",
  CAST(SUM(salary_instructional.salary_outlays) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(salary_instructional.staff_count), 0) AS "avg_instructional_salary"
FROM ipeds_salary_instructional AS salary_instructional
LEFT JOIN ipeds_institution AS institution ON salary_instructional.unitid = institution.unitid
WHERE institution.sector_code = '1'
  AND salary_instructional.contract_length = '9-month'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "academic_rank"

details.question: Which state has the highest staff FTE per 100 students in 2023?
details.sql:
WITH c_staff_fte AS (
  SELECT
    institution.state_abbr AS "state",
    staff_eap.unitid AS "unitid",
    SUM(staff_eap.full_time + staff_eap.part_time / 3.0) AS "staff_fte"
  FROM ipeds_employees_by_position AS staff_eap
  LEFT JOIN ipeds_institution AS institution ON staff_eap.unitid = institution.unitid
  WHERE staff_eap.survey_year = 2023
    AND staff_eap.is_category_total = FALSE
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
c_enrollment_12mo AS (
  SELECT
    institution.state_abbr AS "state",
    enrollment.unitid AS "unitid",
    SUM(enrollment.enrollment_total) AS "enrollment_12mo"
  FROM ipeds_enrollment_12mo AS enrollment
  LEFT JOIN ipeds_institution AS institution ON enrollment.unitid = institution.unitid
  WHERE enrollment.survey_year - 1 = 2023
    AND enrollment.level_code = '1'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  c_staff_fte."state",
  SUM(c_staff_fte."staff_fte") * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(c_enrollment_12mo."enrollment_12mo"), 0) AS "staff_fte_per_100_students"
FROM c_staff_fte
JOIN c_enrollment_12mo ON c_staff_fte."state" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c_enrollment_12mo."state" AND c_staff_fte."unitid" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c_enrollment_12mo."unitid"
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "staff_fte_per_100_students" DESC NULLS LAST, "state"
LIMIT 1

details.question: QCEW employment in Champaign County in 2024
details.sql:
WITH per_period AS (
  SELECT
    qcew.year AS "__period_year",
    qcew.qtr AS "__period_quarter",
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT((qcew.month1_emplvl + qcew.month2_emplvl + qcew.month3_emplvl) / 3.0) THEN SUM((qcew.month1_emplvl + qcew.month2_emplvl + qcew.month3_emplvl) / 3.0) END AS __v
  FROM qcew_combined AS qcew
  WHERE qcew.area_fips = '17019'
    AND qcew.year = 2024
    AND qcew.own_code <> '0'
    AND qcew.industry_code = '611310'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(__v) THEN AVG(__v) END AS "qcew_employment"
FROM per_period

details.question: Total wages in Illinois in Q1 2024
details.sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(qcew.total_qtrly_wages) THEN SUM(qcew.total_qtrly_wages) END AS "qcew_total_wages"
FROM qcew_combined AS qcew
WHERE qcew.area_fips = '17000'
  AND qcew.qtr = 1
  AND qcew.year = 2024
  AND qcew.own_code <> '0'
  AND qcew.industry_code = '611310'

details.question: Hires in Illinois by quarter in 2024
details.sql:
SELECT
  qwi.quarter AS "quarter",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(qwi.hira) THEN SUM(qwi.hira) END AS "qwi_hires"
FROM qwi_higher_ed AS qwi
WHERE qwi.geography = '17'
  AND qwi.year = 2024
  AND qwi.sex = '0'
  AND qwi.agegrp = 'A00'
  AND qwi.industry = '6113'
  AND qwi.ownercode = 'A00'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "quarter"

details.question: QWI average monthly earnings by sex in Illinois
details.sql:
SELECT
  qwi.sex AS "sex",
  CAST(SUM(qwi.earns * qwi.emp_s) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN qwi.earns IS NOT NULL THEN qwi.emp_s END), 0) AS "qwi_avg_monthly_earnings"
FROM qwi_higher_ed AS qwi
WHERE qwi.geography = '17'
  AND qwi.sex <> '0'
  AND qwi.agegrp = 'A00'
  AND qwi.industry = '6113'
  AND qwi.ownercode = 'A00'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "sex"

details.question: Number of core tasks by occupation
details.sql:
SELECT
  onet_occupation.title AS "occupation_title",
  COUNT(*) AS "core_task_count"
FROM onet_task_statement AS onet_task
LEFT JOIN onet_occupation AS onet_occupation ON onet_task.onetsoc_code = onet_occupation.onetsoc_code
WHERE onet_task.task_type = 'Core'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "occupation_title"
